## About
Fahrenheit Auto Performance is a car repair shop in San Pablo that works on all car and truck brands, American, Asian and European. We use computer diagnostics to find the real cause of a problem before we start on the fix.
We handle brakes, wheel alignments, check engine lights, electrical problems, A/C, suspension and transmission work. The shop is licensed by the State of California for smog check inspection and repair, and is an official state licensed brake and lamp adjusting station.
Drivers come in from Richmond, Pinole, El Sobrante, El Cerrito, Berkeley and Rodeo too. Reviewers describe Felix and his team as knowledgeable, friendly and honest, with fair prices.

## Services
- Brakes: Inspection, repair and maintenance of your braking system so you can stop with confidence.
- Wheel alignment: We line up the steering and suspension parts so your car or truck drives smoothly, with less effort.
- Diagnostic testing: Diagnostic testing that gets to the root cause of the problem so the repair is done right.
- Check engine light and dashboard lights: If a warning light comes on, we can tell you what it means and what your car needs.
- Electrical problems: We read your vehicle's data with diagnostic equipment to track down the cause of electrical trouble.
- Brake and lamp adjusting station: A state licensed station for official brake and lamp work, including lamp inspections for vehicles being retitled with a salvage certificate.
- Smog check: Smog check inspection and smog repair from a state licensed station.
- Vehicle A/C: When the air conditioning stops cooling, we can look at your A/C system.
- Suspension: Springs, shocks and struts that keep you from feeling every bump in the road.
- Transmission: Loss of power, a burning smell, clunking or humming can point to a transmission problem. We can check it out.

## FAQ

A: Yes. We service all car and truck brands, American, Asian and European.
